description:
Order a Property Tax Appeal Evidence Pack (PDF + JSON): the parcel's assessment history, appeal outcomes on
        record, comparable sales, a neighborhood assessment-to-sale ratio check computed from the assessor's own data, and
        the filing deadline with the official route. $49 per pack. Then poll
        get_order_status(order_id) until 'complete' (about a minute) and call get_tax_appeal_evidence(order_id).
        Data only: no appeal is filed and no one is represented.
name: order_tax_appeal_evidence
